cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can create an Event Category and Album, add photos, and publish so the album appears correctly on the public site

steps.action: Log in to Liferay CMS as Site Content Editor and create Event Category "Community Outreach" EN/AR, Display Order 4, Publish Status Published.
steps.expected: Category saves with an auto-generated Event Category ID and appears Published.

steps.action: Create Album "QCTEST-Community Day 2026" EN/AR under "Community Outreach", set Published Date 2026-09-15, upload a JPG Album Cover Image, and enter both Title fields.
steps.expected: Album saves with an auto-generated Album ID, audit-logged Created date, and all entered field values retained.

steps.action: Add one photo selected from Documents & Media and one photo uploaded from device, entering Photo Title EN/AR for each, setting Thumbnail Framing, and Display Order values 1 and 2.
steps.expected: Both photos save under the album with their respective metadata and order values, and the album's Parent Album reference for both is this album.

steps.action: Save as Draft, then Preview, then Publish.
steps.expected: Draft state is reachable, Preview renders the entered content, and Publish succeeds with a success toast and an audit log entry.

steps.action: Open the public Photo Albums listing and this album's Details page.
steps.expected: The album appears on the public listing under the "Community Outreach" chip with the correct cover image and photo count, and the Details page shows both photos with the Display-Order-1 photo as the full-width lead photo.

cases.title: Verify that deleting an album removes it from the public site and its Documents & Media references

steps.action: In Liferay CMS, delete "QCTEST-Community Day 2026".
steps.expected: Album is removed from the CMS Albums listing with an audit log entry.

steps.action: Reload the public Photo Albums listing in a fresh logged-out browser context.
